notes: three branches: the first two close with «أخبرنا وكيع» and «جميعا عن شعبة»; the last opens «قال حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد» and reaches the same Shu'ba; the names after the last «حدثنا شعبة» are the shared tail (rule 3)
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor gloss, left out
«أبو جمرة» and «ابن عباس» are reached by all three branches through the tail
